description: This file defines a class 'Cod' for the OpenCart admin extension, specifically implementing a payment method controller for COD (Cash on Delivery). It contains methods for rendering the configuration page and saving the settings, including handling permission checks and setting up the view data.

classes.name: Cod
classes.description: Controller class for the COD payment method in the OpenCart admin extension, extending the base Controller class and providing methods for configuration page rendering and saving settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the configuration page for the COD payment method in the admin panel, setting up breadcrumbs, title, and loading necessary models and view components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the COD payment method, including permission checks and returning a JSON response.
